name: GMR Power And Urban Infra Limited
summary: GMR Power And Urban Infra Limited engages in the energy, urban infrastructure, and transportation businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Power, Smart Meter Infrastructure, Roads, EPC, and Others segments. The company generates energy through coal based thermal plants, hydropower plants, solar, and wind; installation of smart meters; development, operation, and maintenance of highways; and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions for highways and railways, development of special investment region, and others.
